description: This Java source file defines the SensorCentral class, responsible for managing sensor values and listeners within the project. It implements the ISensorCentral interface and provides methods to get/set sensor values, add/remove listeners, and initialize sensors from an EngineState. It also contains nested interfaces for sensor event listeners.

classes.name: SensorCentral
classes.description: Manages sensor values and listeners, providing thread-safe access and update mechanisms, and initialization of sensor states.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SensorCentral.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value for a given sensor.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for a sensor and notifies listeners if the value changed.

methods.name: setAnySensorListener
methods.description: Registers a listener that is notified on updates from any sensor.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for a specific sensor.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener for a specific sensor.

methods.name: getValueSource
methods.description: Provides a ValueSource functional interface for a sensor.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes various sensors with values from the EngineState.
